DIAMETER::payload
Description
This iRules command gets or sets DIAMETER message payload
Syntax
DIAMETER
::
payload
DIAMETER
::
payload
replace
"newpayload"
DIAMETER::payload
returns message payload (all AVPs)
DIAMETER::payload replace “newpayload”
replace existing payload with “newpayload”. This is for lowe level
AVP manipulation
